summary.text: Kelby Timmons is a Republican member of the North Dakota House of Representatives, representing District 26 (home city listed as Watford City), serving from 2023 to 2024 and since 2025 per the legislature's member page.

paragraphs.text: The legislature's biography for Timmons lists an occupation of Nickel Plater.
It lists education as Johnson Corners Christian Academy.
Family is listed as: Married (Andrea), 1 son.
